policy: Official GTCRN DNS3 weights in FP32. One forward pass over each original complete, decoded 16 kHz FIFO on the host GPU. Square-root Hann STFT (512 samples, hop 256) following infer.py, explicit original sample count for ISTFT. No prompt, crop, remixed original signal, or threshold selection. Four fixed Nyx interference cells and the original Willow full-mixture comparator. The three Nyx source-mute cells keep the original full-mixture open.
